verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented bulk or batch action, such as bulk bill payment, batch card issuance or mass-editing transactions. The closest items are adjacent features: rule-based auto-transfers that split one deposit across several accounts, and a capacity of 50 cards. A community user also notes that external payments still have to be executed manually.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
